mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_plan (id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,run_key,policy_ref,cutoff_at,manifest_hash,state,requested_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{enterprise},#{warehouse},#{run},#{policy},#{cutoff},REPEAT('0',64),'PLANNING',#{actor},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM archive_plan WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterprise} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouse} AND run_key=#{run} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_plan SET cursor_id=#{cursor},candidate_count=candidate_count+#{count},manifest_hash=#{hash},state=#{state},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterprise} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouse} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state='PLANNING'
